activeVersion.name: Skip unchanged files, drop per-item loop
activeVersion.description: The loop version backed up all 442 workflows but took 39 min and made one GitHub commit per workflow every night (close to GitHub's 500 writes/hour limit). Now: read the repo file list once, fetch each workflow in one batched node run, compare its git blob SHA with the repo, and commit only new or changed files (one at a time, 1s apart). Summary reports changed, new, unchanged and failed counts.
